title: C&F Financial Corporation Announces Sale of Interest in Bearing Insurance Group and Executes Strategic Restructuring of Securities Portfolio
summary: TOANO, Va., May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CF Financial Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ:CFFI), the holding company for CF Bank, today announced the completion of the sale (the Transaction) of the Corporation’s interest (held by CF Bank’s subsidiary, CF Insurance Services, LLC) in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC (Bearing) to an unaffiliated third party, effective May 1, 2026. Based solely on information available to the Corporation on the date hereof, the Corporation estimates that a pre-tax gain of approximately $8.3 million will be recognized on the Transaction, which will be included in the Corporation’s financial results for the second quarter of 2026. Following the completion of the Transaction, the Corporation executed a strategic restructuring of a portion of its securities available for sale (AFS) portfolio (the Portfolio Restructuring), which will offset a portion of the gain from the Transaction.
